**The Stokes phenomenon for the Ramanujan’s q -diﬀerence equation and its higher order extension**

*Takeshi MORITA∗*

22 pp, 10 sections.

**Abstract.** We show connection formulae of local solutions of the Ramanu- jan equation between the origin and the inﬁnity. These solutions are given by the Ramanujan function, the q-Airy function and the diver- gent basic hypergeometric series 2ϕ0(0, 0; −; q, x). We use two diﬀerent q-Borel-Laplace resummation methods to obtain our connection for- mulae. We also introduce the q-Borel-Laplace transformation of level r−1, which are higher order extension of these transformations. These methods are useful to obtain an asymptotic formula of a divergent se- ries rϕ0(0, 0, . . . , 0; −; q, x).
